config.layer_rule: best single hidden state of the fold's own E2 phase-A validation macro-F1 (max over poolings; ties -> lower layer)  [identical to E3]
config.selection_metric: validation macro-F1 (ties -> earlier candidate; dropout outer, lr descending inner)
config.positional_encoding: none (as in the E3 control): cross-attention is content-based and does not encode the shared frame positions; the model is invariant to joint time permutation
